questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Several factors influenced my decision to study in Milan. First, its reputation as a global hub for fashion, design, and business aligned with my academic and career interests. Additionally, the city's vibrant culture, historical significance, and central location in Europe made it an ideal place to broaden my horizons both personally and professionally. The opportunity to connect with international students and experience a different way of life also played a crucial role in my choice.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *

1. Enjoy it - time flies!
2. Be brave and open-minded! 
3. Money will come back, but memories won't!
